general_information.name: UM—SORRY, DO YOU MEAN LIKE THE NAME ON MY ID? I ALWAYS GET THROWN BY THAT ONE. I CAN GIVE YOU PART OF IT, I GUESS, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE FORMAL VERSION OR JUST WHAT PEOPLE CALL ME DAY TO DAY.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly my mood, I think—around my period it gets really bad, like I get irritable and everything feels off, and then it spills into relationships. Outside of that I’m generally okay.
current_concerns.goals: I want the mood swings under control, honestly. And to stop it from messing up my relationships.

past_psychiatric_history.self_harm_details: It was cutting, back in adolescence and after that too at times, but only as a way to calm myself down. There isn’t any current or immediate safety concern, and I’m not having suicidal thoughts.
